findings.summary: The vertical panel's scale is set by one slice. The excursion near slice 40 drops about 6 mm below the rest of the trace, so the panel is drawn over roughly 11 mm with ticks only at 0.498 and 0.493, while the vertical scatter the study reports away from that slice is 0.26 mm, about 3 percent of the panel height and a few pixels. A reader can see that the vertical trace is jagged but cannot read the size or the memory of the vertical motion. The caption explains the slice-40 excursion, which is what keeps the compression understandable, so this does not hold the node.

Every null marker encodes its series rather than its null type. nova keeps the project vocabulary (filled triangle for the axis, filled plus for the saddle), but imas-efit's axis is an open square and its saddle an open diamond, and the generating state's axis a hollow circle, so a reader who reads the triangle-and-cross convention cannot tell which of imas-efit's two marks is the axis and which the saddle. Because the three axis positions sit within about two millimetres of one another at machine scale, the three axis markers overlap into a single figure-of-eight blot at the plasma centre, and the caption's millimetre annotation supplies the separations the marks cannot show, which is why this does not hold the node.

The figure carries a third mark the legend does not name. A dotted grey line marks the generating state's own axis, and neither the two-entry legend nor this figure's caption identifies it; the neighbouring nova caption does, and this caption says only that the column is 'on the same axes'. A reader meeting this figure on its own, as on a slide, cannot say what the dotted line is or why the trace is read against it.

notes: Read-only figure review. The three attached PNGs were opened with the Read tool and judged on the rendered pixels, including crops of those same PNGs for marker shape and border clipping; no SVG was read, rendered, listed or shown, and no image other than the three named PNGs was opened. The contrast ratios and white-coverage percentages quoted here are sampled from those PNGs. The PNG-to-figure mapping comes from the attachment order plus legend colour (green is imas-efit, blue is nova as the overlay caption states) and the caption text.
